;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (two forms)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? name-or-list)
                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define x expr)
                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 ;; arity check (simple)
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (begin
          (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
            (if (or (eq? expr #f) (eq? expr None))
                (begin (fclose fid))
                (begin
                  ;; Evaluate each top-level expression from the file using our evaluator
                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))

;; End of eval.scm

  (cond ((< n 2) #f)
        ((= n 2) #t)

        (else

           (cond ((> (* d d) n) #t)

    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity handling).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)

    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (two forms)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? name-or-list)
                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define x expr)
                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 ;; arity check (simple)
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))

                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))

;; eval.scm -- metacircular evaluator for the interp.py Scheme dialect
;; Read one line (an S-expression) from stdin which is the filename to interpret.
;; Then interpret that file, using the remaining stdin as the interpreted program's stdin.

;; Basic list helpers
(define (list-length lst)
  (if (null? lst) 0 (+ 1 (list-length (cdr lst)))))

(define (nth lst n)
  (if (= n 0) (car lst) (nth (cdr lst) (- n 1))))

(define (append a b)
  (if (null? a) b (cons (car a) (append (cdr a) b))))

(define (map f lst)
  (if (null? lst) '() (cons (f (car lst)) (map f (cdr lst)))))

;; Environment operations: env is a list of frames; frame is an alist (list of (cons name value))
(define (make-frame bindings) bindings)

(define (extend-env frame env)
  (cons frame env))

(define (lookup-in-frame name frame)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (cdr b)
            (lookup-in-frame name (cdr frame))))))

(define (lookup name env)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let ((val (lookup-in-frame name (car env))))
        (if val val (lookup name (cdr env))))))

(define (set-in-frame name frame val)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (begin (set-car! b name) (set-cdr! b val) #t)
            (set-in-frame name (cdr frame) val)))))

(define (env-set! name env val)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable in set!: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (if (set-in-frame name (car env) val) #t (env-set! name (cdr env) val))))

(define (env-define name env val)
  ;; define in the first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity handling).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (two forms)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? name-or-list)
                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define x expr)
                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 ;; arity check (simple)
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (begin
          (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
            (if (or (eq? expr #f) (eq? expr None))
                (begin (fclose fid))
                (begin
                  ;; Evaluate each top-level expression from the file using our evaluator
                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))

;; End of eval.scm
'

You are tasked with answering a query with associated context. You can access, transform, and analyze this context interactively in a REPL environment that can recursively query sub-LLMs, which you are strongly encouraged to use as much as possible. You will be queried iteratively until you provide a final answer.

The REPL environment is initialized with:
1. A `context` variable that contains extremely important information about your query. You should check the content of the `context` variable to understand what you are working with. Make sure you look through it sufficiently as you answer your query.
2. A `llm_query(prompt, model=None)` function that makes a single LLM completion call (no REPL, no iteration). Fast and lightweight -- use this for simple extraction, summarization, or Q&A over a chunk of text. The sub-LLM can handle around 500K chars.
3. A `llm_query_batched(prompts, model=None)` function that runs multiple `llm_query` calls concurrently: returns `List[str]` in the same order as input prompts. Much faster than sequential `llm_query` calls for independent queries.
4. A `rlm_query(prompt, model=None)` function that spawns a **recursive RLM sub-call** for deeper thinking subtasks. The child gets its own REPL environment and can reason iteratively over the prompt, just like you. Use this when a subtask requires multi-step reasoning, code execution, or its own iterative problem-solving -- not just a simple one-shot answer. Falls back to `llm_query` if recursion is not available.
5. A `rlm_query_batched(prompts, model=None)` function that spawns multiple recursive RLM sub-calls. Each prompt gets its own child RLM. Falls back to `llm_query_batched` if recursion is not available.
6. A `SHOW_VARS()` function that returns all variables you have created in the REPL. Use this to check what variables exist before using FINAL_VAR.
7. The ability to use `print()` statements to view the output of your REPL code and continue your reasoning.


**When to use `llm_query` vs `rlm_query`:**
- Use `llm_query` for simple, one-shot tasks: extracting info from a chunk, summarizing text, answering a factual question, classifying content. These are fast single LLM calls.
- You must use `rlm_query` when the subtask itself requires any forms of deeper thinking: multi-step reasoning, solving a sub-problem that needs its own REPL and iteration, or tasks where a single LLM call might not be enough. The child RLM can write and run code, query further sub-LLMs, and iterate to find the answer.

**Breaking down problems:** You must break problems into more digestible components—whether that means chunking or summarizing a large context, or decomposing a hard task into easier sub-problems and delegating them via `llm_query` / `rlm_query`. Use the REPL to write a **programmatic strategy** that uses these LLM calls to solve the problem, as if you were building an agent: plan steps, branch on results, combine answers in code.

**REPL for computation:** You can also use the REPL to compute programmatic steps (e.g. `math.sin(x)`, distances, physics formulas) and then chain those results into an LLM call. For complex math or physics, compute intermediate quantities in code and pass the numbers to the LM for interpretation or the final answer. Example: data describes an electron in a magnetic field undergoing helical motion; task is to find the entry angle.
```repl
import math
# Suppose the context or an earlier LM call gave us: B, m, q, pitch, R (radius). Extract or set them.
# Helical motion: v_parallel = pitch * (q*B)/(2*pi*m), v_perp = R * (q*B)/m. Entry angle theta: tan(theta) = v_perp/v_parallel.
v_parallel = pitch * (q * B) / (2 * math.pi * m)
v_perp = R * (q * B) / m
theta_rad = math.atan2(v_perp, v_parallel)
theta_deg = math.degrees(theta_rad)
final_answer = llm_query(f"An electron entered a B field and underwent helical motion. Computed entry angle: {theta_deg:.2f} deg. State the answer clearly for the user.")
```

You will find this function especially useful when you have to analyze the semantics of the context. Use these variables as buffers to build up your final answer.

Your interpreter should be able to interpret (1) each of the test programs in test/, and (2) itself.
For example, the following three commands should all do the same thing:
echo '(+ 7 8)' | python3 interp.py test/calculator.scm
echo -e 'test/calculator.scm\n(+ 7 8)' | python3 interp.py eval.scm
echo -e 'eval.scm\ntest/calculator.scm\n(+ 7 8)' | python3 interp.py eval.scm
The first of these will add 7 and 8 because that is what calculator.scm does.
The second will run eval.scm, which takes test/calculator.scm as the file to run, and runs it; that program then computes 7+8.
The third will run eval.scm, which then takes eval.scm as the input, the outer eval.scm interprets the inner eval.scm which then runs the calculator as above.

    (cond ((= n 1) steps)
          ((= (- n (* (/ n 2) 2)) 0)

(define (is-prime? n)
  (cond ((< n 2) #f)
        ((= n 2) #t)
        ((= (- n (* (/ n 2) 2)) 0) #f)
        (else
         (define (check d)
           (cond ((> (* d d) n) #t)
                 ((= (- n (* (/ n d) d)) 0) #f)
                 (else (check (+ d 2)))))
         (check 3))))

;; eval.scm -- metacircular evaluator for the interp.py Scheme dialect
;; Read one line (an S-expression) from stdin which is the filename to interpret.
;; Then interpret that file, using the remaining stdin as the interpreted program's stdin.

;; Basic list helpers
(define (list-length lst)
  (if (null? lst) 0 (+ 1 (list-length (cdr lst)))))

(define (nth lst n)
  (if (= n 0) (car lst) (nth (cdr lst) (- n 1))))

(define (append a b)
  (if (null? a) b (cons (car a) (append (cdr a) b))))

(define (map f lst)
  (if (null? lst) '() (cons (f (car lst)) (map f (cdr lst)))))

;; Environment operations: env is a list of frames; frame is an alist (list of (cons name value))
(define (make-frame bindings) bindings)

(define (extend-env frame env)
  (cons frame env))

(define (lookup-in-frame name frame)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (cdr b)
            (lookup-in-frame name (cdr frame))))))

(define (lookup name env)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let ((val (lookup-in-frame name (car env))))
        (if val val (lookup name (cdr env))))))

(define (set-in-frame name frame val)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (begin (set-car! b name) (set-cdr! b val) #t)
            (set-in-frame name (cdr frame) val)))))

(define (env-set! name env val)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable in set!: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (if (set-in-frame name (car env) val) #t (env-set! name (cdr env) val))))

(define (env-define name env val)
  ;; define in the first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity handling).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f

You are tasked with answering a query with associated context. You can access, transform, and analyze this context interactively in a REPL environment that can recursively query sub-LLMs, which you are strongly encouraged to use as much as possible. The REPL environment is initialized with:

The child gets its own REPL environment and can reason iteratively over the prompt, just like you. Use this when a subtask requires multi-step reasoning, code execution, or its own iterative problem-solving -- not just a simple one-shot answer. Falls back to `llm_query` if recursion is not available.

- You must use `rlm_query` when the subtask itself requires any forms of deeper thinking: multi-step reasoning, solving a sub-problem that needs its own REPL and iteration, or tasks where a single LLM call might not be enough. ;; eval.scm -- metacircular evaluator for the interp.py Scheme dialect
;; Read one line (an S-expression) from stdin which is the filename to interpret.
;; Then interpret that file, using the remaining stdin as the interpreted program's stdin.

;; Basic list helpers
(define (list-length lst)
  (if (null? lst) 0 (+ 1 (list-length (cdr lst)))))

(define (nth lst n)
  (if (= n 0) (car lst) (nth (cdr lst) (- n 1))))

(define (append a b)
  (if (null? a) b (cons (car a) (append (cdr a) b))))

(define (map f lst)
  (if (null? lst) '() (cons (f (car lst)) (map f (cdr lst)))))

;; Environment operations: env is a list of frames; frame is an alist (list of (cons name value))
(define (make-frame bindings) bindings)

(define (extend-env frame env)
  (cons frame env))

(define (lookup-in-frame name frame)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (cdr b)
            (lookup-in-frame name (cdr frame))))))

(define (lookup name env)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let ((val (lookup-in-frame name (car env))))
        (if val val (lookup name (cdr env))))))

(define (set-in-frame name frame val)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (begin (set-car! b name) (set-cdr! b val) #t)
            (set-in-frame name (cdr frame) val)))))

(define (env-set! name env val)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable in set!: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (if (set-in-frame name (car env) val) #t (env-set! name (cdr env) val))))

(define (env-define name env val)
  ;; define in the first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity handling).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (two forms)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? name-or-list)
                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define x expr)
                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 ;; arity check (simple)
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (begin
          (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
            (if (or (eq? expr #f) (eq? expr None))
                (begin (fclose fid))
                (begin
                  ;; Evaluate each top-level expression from the file using our evaluator
                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))

;; End of eval.scm
'

;; eval.scm -- metacircular evaluator for the interp.py Scheme dialect
;; Read one line (an S-expression) from stdin which is the filename to interpret.
;; Then interpret that file, using the remaining stdin as the interpreted program's stdin.

;; Basic list helpers
(define (list-length lst)
  (if (null? lst) 0 (+ 1 (list-length (cdr lst)))))

(define (nth lst n)
  (if (= n 0) (car lst) (nth (cdr lst) (- n 1))))

(define (append a b)
  (if (null? a) b (cons (car a) (append (cdr a) b))))

(define (map f lst)
  (if (null? lst) '() (cons (f (car lst)) (map f (cdr lst)))))

;; Environment operations: env is a list of frames; frame is an alist (list of (cons name value))
(define (make-frame bindings) bindings)

(define (extend-env frame env)
  (cons frame env))

(define (lookup-in-frame name frame)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (cdr b)
            (lookup-in-frame name (cdr frame))))))

(define (lookup name env)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let ((val (lookup-in-frame name (car env))))
        (if val val (lookup name (cdr env))))))

(define (set-in-frame name frame val)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (begin (set-car! b name) (set-cdr! b val) #t)
            (set-in-frame name (cdr frame) val)))))

(define (env-set! name env val)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable in set!: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (if (set-in-frame name (car env) val) #t (env-set! name (cdr env) val))))

(define (env-define name env val)
  ;; define in the first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity handling).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (two forms)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? name-or-list)
                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define x expr)
                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 ;; arity check (simple)
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (begin
          (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
            (if (or (eq? expr #f) (eq? expr None))
                (begin (fclose fid))
                (begin
                  ;; Evaluate each top-level expression from the file using our evaluator
                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))

;; End of eval.scm
'

You are tasked with answering a query with associated context. You can access, transform, and analyze this context interactively in a REPL environment that can recursively query sub-LLMs, which you are strongly encouraged to use as much as possible. You will be queried iteratively until you provide a final answer.

The REPL environment is initialized with:
1. A `context` variable that contains extremely important information about your query. You should check the content of the `context` variable to understand what you are working with. Make sure you look through it sufficiently as you answer your query.
2. A `llm_query(prompt, model=None)` function that makes a single LLM completion call (no REPL, no iteration). Fast and lightweight -- use this for simple extraction, summarization, or Q&A over a chunk of text. The sub-LLM can handle around 500K chars.
3. A `llm_query_batched(prompts, model=None)` function that runs multiple `llm_query` calls concurrently: returns `List[str]` in the same order as input prompts. Much faster than sequential `llm_query` calls for independent queries.
4. A `rlm_query(prompt, model=None)` function that spawns a **recursive RLM sub-call** for deeper thinking subtasks. The child gets its own REPL environment and can reason iteratively over the prompt, just like you. Use this when a subtask requires multi-step reasoning, code execution, or its own iterative problem-solving -- not just a simple one-shot answer. Falls back to `llm_query` if recursion is not available.
5. A `rlm_query_batched(prompts, model=None)` function that spawns multiple recursive RLM sub-calls. Each prompt gets its own child RLM. Falls back to `llm_query_batched` if recursion is not available.
6. A `SHOW_VARS()` function that returns all variables you have created in the REPL. Use this to check what variables exist before using FINAL_VAR.
7. The ability to use `print()` statements to view the output of your REPL code and continue your reasoning.


**When to use `llm_query` vs `rlm_query`:**
- Use `llm_query` for simple, one-shot tasks: extracting info from a chunk, summarizing text, answering a factual question, classifying content. These are fast single LLM calls.
- You must use `rlm_query` when the subtask itself requires any forms of deeper thinking: multi-step reasoning, solving a sub-problem that needs its own REPL and iteration, or tasks where a single LLM call might not be enough. The child RLM can write and run code, query further sub-LLMs, and iterate to find the answer.

**Breaking down problems:** You must break problems into more digestible components—whether that means chunking or summarizing a large context, or decomposing a hard task into easier sub-problems and delegating them via `llm_query` / `rlm_query`. Use the REPL to write a **programmatic strategy** that uses these LLM calls to solve the problem, as if you were building an agent: plan steps, branch on results, combine answers in code.

**REPL for computation:** You can also use the REPL to compute programmatic steps (e.g. `math.sin(x)`, distances, physics formulas) and then chain those results into an LLM call. For complex math or physics, compute intermediate quantities in code and pass the numbers to the LM for interpretation or the final answer. Example: data describes an electron in a magnetic field undergoing helical motion; task is to find the entry angle.
```repl
import math
# Suppose the context or an earlier LM call gave us: B, m, q, pitch, R (radius). Extract or set them.
# Helical motion: v_parallel = pitch * (q*B)/(2*pi*m), v_perp = R * (q*B)/m. Entry angle theta: tan(theta) = v_perp/v_parallel.
v_parallel = pitch * (q * B) / (2 * math.pi * m)
v_perp = R * (q * B) / m
theta_rad = math.atan2(v_perp, v_parallel)
theta_deg = math.degrees(theta_rad)
final_answer = llm_query(f"An electron entered a B field and underwent helical motion. Computed entry angle: {theta_deg:.2f} deg. State the answer clearly for the user.")
```

You will find this function especially useful when you have to analyze the semantics of the context. Use these variables as buffers to build up your final answer.
Make sure to explicitly look through the entire context in REPL before answering your query. Break the context and the problem into digestible pieces: e.g. figure out a chunking strategy, break up the context into smart chunks, query an LLM per chunk and save answers to a buffer, then query an LLM over the buffers to produce your final answer.

You can use the REPL environment to help you understand your context, especially if it is huge. Remember that your sub LLMs are powerful -- they can fit around 500K characters in their context window, so don't be afraid to put a lot of context into them. trend = rlm_query(f"Analyze this dataset and conclude with one word: up, down, or stable: {data}")

            (cdr b)
            (lookup-in-frame name (cdr frame))))))

(define (lookup name env)

      (begin (display "Unbound variable: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let ((val (lookup-in-frame name (car env))))
        (if val val (lookup name (cdr env))))))

  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (begin (set-car! b name) (set-cdr! b val) #t)
            (set-in-frame name (cdr frame) val)))))

  ;; define in the first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))

(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))

                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))

                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ((eq? op 'set!)

            (env-set! name env val)

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)

                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))

         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))

                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))

                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))

         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 ;; arity check (simple)
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (begin
          (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
            (if (or (eq? expr #f) (eq? expr None))
                (begin (fclose fid))
                (begin
                  ;; Evaluate each top-level expression from the file using our evaluator
                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))

;; eval.scm -- metacircular evaluator for interp.py Scheme dialect
;; Reads one S-expression filename from stdin, opens that file, and interprets it.
;; Uses interp.py provided primitives (read, fopen, fread, display, newline, etc.)

;; Basic helpers
(define (list-length lst)
  (if (null? lst) 0 (+ 1 (list-length (cdr lst)))))

(define (nth lst n)
  (if (= n 0) (car lst) (nth (cdr lst) (- n 1))))

(define (alist-get name alist)
  (if (null? alist) #f
      (let ((pair (car alist)))
        (if (eq? (car pair) name)
            (cdr pair)
            (alist-get name (cdr alist))))))

;; Environment: list of frames, each frame is an alist (list of (cons name value))
(define (env-lookup name env)
  (if (null? env)
      #f
      (let ((val (alist-get name (car env))))
        (if val val (env-lookup name (cdr env))))))

(define (env-define! name env val)
  ;; define in first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

(define (env-set! name env val)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable in set!: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let loop ((frame (car env)) (rest (cdr env)))
        (let ((pair (alist-get name frame)))
          (if pair
              ;; replace in this frame: remove old and cons new to keep things simple
              (begin (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) (cdr (car env)))) #t)
              (if (null? rest)
                  (env-set! name rest val)
                  (loop (car rest) (cdr rest))))))))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive (call Python-callable objects available in this interpreter)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a sequence of expressions, returning last value
(define (eval-seq exprs env)
  (if (null? exprs)
      #f
      (if (null? (cdr exprs))
          (meval (car exprs) env)
          (begin (meval (car exprs) env) (eval-seq (cdr exprs) env)))))

;; Metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; symbol
    ((symbol? expr) (env-lookup expr env))

    ;; self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr)

    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (var or function shorthand)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((target (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? target)
                ;; (define (fname params...) body...)
                (let ((fname (car target))
                      (params (cdr target))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define! fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define name value)
                (let ((val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define! target env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let (simple implementation)
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let ((frame '()))
              (let loop ((b bindings) (fr frame))
                (if (null? b)
                    (eval-seq body (cons fr env))
                    (let ((pair (car b)))
                      (loop (cdr b) (cons (cons (car pair) (meval (cadr pair) env)) fr))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-seq (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses)
                #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-seq (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let ((proc (meval op env))
                (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))
                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let apply-bind ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (eval-seq body (cons fr cenv))
                             (apply-bind (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              (else
               (apply-primitive proc args)))))))))

;; Build initial-frame mapping to primitives available here
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
          (if (or (eq? expr #f) (null? expr))
              (begin (fclose fid))
              (begin (meval expr global-env) (loop (fread fid))))))))

;; end
'

          (if (or (eq? expr #f) (null? expr))
              (begin (fclose fid))
              (begin (meval expr global-env) (loop (fread fid))))))))

'
;; eval.scm -- metacircular evaluator for the interp.py Scheme dialect
;; Read one line (an S-expression) from stdin which is the filename to interpret.
;; Then interpret that file, using the remaining stdin as the interpreted program's stdin.

;; Basic list helpers
(define (list-length lst)
  (if (null? lst) 0 (+ 1 (list-length (cdr lst)))))

(define (nth lst n)
  (if (= n 0) (car lst) (nth (cdr lst) (- n 1))))

(define (append a b)
  (if (null? a) b (cons (car a) (append (cdr a) b))))

(define (map f lst)
  (if (null? lst) '() (cons (f (car lst)) (map f (cdr lst)))))

;; Environment operations: env is a list of frames; frame is an alist (list of (cons name value))
(define (make-frame bindings) bindings)

(define (extend-env frame env)
  (cons frame env))

(define (lookup-in-frame name frame)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (cdr b)
            (lookup-in-frame name (cdr frame))))))

(define (lookup name env)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (let ((val (lookup-in-frame name (car env))))
        (if val val (lookup name (cdr env))))))

(define (set-in-frame name frame val)
  (if (null? frame)
      #f
      (let ((b (car frame)))
        (if (eq? (car b) name)
            (begin (set-car! b name) (set-cdr! b val) #t)
            (set-in-frame name (cdr frame) val)))))

(define (env-set! name env val)
  (if (null? env)
      (begin (display "Unbound variable in set!: ") (display name) (newline) #f)
      (if (set-in-frame name (car env) val) #t (env-set! name (cdr env) val))))

(define (env-define name env val)
  ;; define in the first frame
  (let ((frame (car env)))
    (set! (car env) (cons (cons name val) frame))
    #t))

;; Closure representation: (closure params body env)
(define (make-closure params body env)
  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body (cons env '())))))

(define (closure? obj)
  (and (pair? obj) (eq? (car obj) 'closure)))

(define (closure-params clo) (cadr clo))
(define (closure-body clo) (caddr clo))
(define (closure-env clo) (cadddr clo))

;; Apply primitive/procedure for up to many args (unrolled)
(define (apply-primitive proc args)
  (let ((n (list-length args)))
    (cond ((= n 0) (proc))
          ((= n 1) (proc (nth args 0)))
          ((= n 2) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1)))
          ((= n 3) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)))
          ((= n 4) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
          ((= n 5) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4)))
          ((= n 6) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5)))
          ((= n 7) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6)))
          ((= n 8) (proc (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3) (nth args 4) (nth args 5) (nth args 6) (nth args 7)))
          (else (begin (display "Too many args to primitive (increase arity handling).") (newline) #f)))))

;; Evaluate a list of expressions in env, return last value
(define (eval-sequence seq env)
  (if (null? seq) #f
      (begin
        (if (null? (cdr seq))
            (meval (car seq) env)
            (begin (meval (car seq) env) (eval-sequence (cdr seq) env))))))

;; The metacircular evaluator
(define (meval expr env)
  (cond
    ;; Symbols
    ((symbol? expr) (lookup expr env))

    ;; Self-evaluating
    ((number? expr) expr)
    ((string? expr) expr)
    ((not (pair? expr)) expr) ; booleans are not pairs, return as-is

    ;; Special forms and applications
    (else
     (let ((op (car expr)))
       (cond
         ;; quote
         ((eq? op 'quote) (cadr expr))

         ;; if
         ((eq? op 'if)
          (let ((test (meval (cadr expr) env)))
            (if (not (eq? test #f))
                (meval (caddr expr) env)
                (if (null? (cdddr expr))
                    #f
                    (meval (cadddr expr) env)))))

         ;; define (two forms)
         ((eq? op 'define)
          (let ((name-or-list (cadr expr)))
            (if (pair? name-or-list)
                ;; (define (f args) body...)
                (let ((fname (car name-or-list))
                      (params (cdr name-or-list))
                      (body (cddr expr)))
                  (env-define fname env (make-closure params body env))
                  #f)
                ;; (define x expr)
                (let ((name name-or-list)
                      (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
                  (env-define name env val)
                  #f))))

         ;; set!
         ((eq? op 'set!)
          (let ((name (cadr expr))
                (val (meval (caddr expr) env)))
            (env-set! name env val)
            #f))

         ;; lambda
         ((eq? op 'lambda)
          (let ((params (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (make-closure params body env)))

         ;; let -> transform to application of lambda
         ((eq? op 'let)
          (let ((bindings (cadr expr))
                (body (cddr expr)))
            (let loop ((bn bindings) (params '()) (args '()))
              (if (null? bn)
                  (meval (cons (cons 'apply (cons (cons (lambda (params) body) '() ) '())) '()) env) ; not used, fallback
                  (let ((b (car bn)))
                    (loop (cdr bn) (append params (cons (car b) '())) (append args (cons (meval (cadr b) env) '()))))))))

         ;; begin / progn
         ((or (eq? op 'begin) (eq? op 'progn))
          (eval-sequence (cdr expr) env))

         ;; cond
         ((eq? op 'cond)
          (let loop ((clauses (cdr expr)))
            (if (null? clauses) #f
                (let ((cl (car clauses)))
                  (let ((test (car cl)))
                    (if (or (eq? test 'else) (not (eq? (meval test env) #f)))
                        (eval-sequence (cdr cl) env)
                        (loop (cdr clauses))))))))

         ;; application
         (else
          (let* ((proc (meval op env))
                 (args (map (lambda (e) (meval e env)) (cdr expr))))
            (cond
              ;; user-defined closure
              ((closure? proc)
               (let ((params (closure-params proc))
                     (body (closure-body proc))
                     (cenv (closure-env proc)))

                 (if (not (= (list-length params) (list-length args)))
                     (begin (display "Arity mismatch in closure") (newline) #f)
                     (let ((frame '()))
                       (let loop2 ((ps params) (as args) (fr '()))
                         (if (null? ps)
                             (let ((new-env (extend-env fr cenv)))
                               (eval-sequence body new-env))
                             (loop2 (cdr ps) (cdr as) (cons (cons (car ps) (car as)) fr))))))))
              ;; primitive (callable)
              ((or (not (pair? proc)) (and (pair? proc) (not (eq? (car proc) 'closure))))
               (apply-primitive proc args))
              (else (begin (display "Unknown procedure type") (newline) #f)))))))))

;; Build initial frame mapping symbol names to the existing primitives (available at top-level)
(define initial-frame
  (list
    (cons '+ +) (cons '- -) (cons '* *) (cons '/ /)
    (cons '= =) (cons '< <) (cons '> >) (cons '<= <=) (cons '>= >=)
    (cons 'cons cons) (cons 'car car) (cons 'cdr cdr)
    (cons 'null? null?) (cons 'pair? pair?)
    (cons 'eq? eq?) (cons 'equal? equal?)
    (cons 'not not) (cons 'and and) (cons 'or or)
    (cons 'getchr getchr) (cons 'putchr putchr) (cons 'chr chr)
    (cons 'read read) (cons 'symbol symbol)
    (cons 'symbol? symbol?) (cons 'string? string?) (cons 'number? number?)
    (cons 'set-car! set-car!) (cons 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)
    (cons 'else else)
    (cons 'display display) (cons 'newline newline)
    (cons 'fopen fopen) (cons 'fclose fclose) (cons 'fgetchr fgetchr)
    (cons 'fputchr fputchr) (cons 'fdisplay fdisplay) (cons 'fread fread)
  ))

;; Global environment: a list with initial-frame as the first frame
(define global-env (cons initial-frame '()))

;; Main: read filename (one S-expression), open it, and interpret its contents.
(let ((fname (read)))
  ;; fname is typically a symbol (string), acceptable to fopen
  (let ((fid (fopen fname "r")))
    (if (eq? fid #f)
        (begin (display "Could not open file: ") (display fname) (newline))
        (begin
          (let loop ((expr (fread fid)))
            (if (or (eq? expr #f) (eq? expr None))
                (begin (fclose fid))
                (begin
                  ;; Evaluate each top-level expression from the file using our evaluator
                  (meval expr global-env)
                  (loop (fread fid)))))))))
